 EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT 
 
 THIS EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT (the “ Agreement ”) is made as of [● ] (the “ Effective Date ”) by and between: 
 
 Online Clas sifieds Pakistan (SMC-Private) Limited , a private limited company, registered under the laws of Pakistan, having its registered place of business located at 2 nd floor of E-E Gulberg III, Lahore, Pakistan (hereinaf ter referred to as the “ Company ” which expression shall mean and include its successors in interest and permitted assigns) ; 
 
 AND 
 
 [● Employee Name ] , holding CNIC No. [●] resident of [●] (hereinafter referred to as the “ Employee ” which expression shall mean and include his/her successors in interest and permitted assign s ) , 
 
 (The Company and the Employee shall hereinafter collectively be referred to as the “ Parties ” and individually as the “ Party ”). 
 
 WHEREAS 
 
 The Company intends to engage the Employee on an exclusive and full-time basis for the purposes of carrying out the duties assigned under this Agreement . 
 
 The Employee represents that the Employee has the relevant skill sets, qualification and experience required for the purposes of discharging t he duties to be assigned by the Company . 
 
 The Parties have agreed to enter into this Agreement to reduce into writing, the terms and conditions t hat shall govern their relationship inter se as an employer and employee . 
 
 
 NOW THEREFORE in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements hereinafter set forth, the receipt and sufficiency of which is hereby acknowledged, each of the P arties hereto hereby agrees as follows: 
 
 ARTICLE 1 – DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION 
 
 1.1 Definitions: The following terms (except as otherwise expressly provided or unless the context otherwise requires) for all purposes of this Agreement shall have the respective meanings hereinafter specified: 
 
 “ Affiliate ” means, with respect to any Person, any other Person directly or indirectly controlling, controlled by, or under common control with such Person. For purposes of this definition, “control” shall mean the direct or indirect ownership of a majority shareholding or other ownership interests in such Person and the ability to elect or appoint a majority of the board of directors (if a corporation) and otherwise to direct the management, policies and business affairs of such Person. 
 
 “ Agreement” means this Employment Agreement incorporating any schedules attached hereto as originally executed by the parties hereto and any amendments, modifications or supplements thereof from time to time introduced and duly signed by the parties hereto. 
 
 " Applicable Laws " means the Laws of Pakistan. 
 
 “Confidential Information” means, without limitation, any and all: 
 
 Software : All information relating to existing software products, whether owned and/or licensed and/or developed by the Company, and software programs and products in various stages of research and such other development which is not generally known to the public or within the computer industry or trade in which the Company competes (such as know-how, design specifications, algorithms, technical formulas, engineering data, benchmark test results, methodologies, procedures, techniques, and information processing processes) including, but not limited to, models, consumer behavior insights, mathematical expressions, algorithms and proprietary marketing concepts, and the physical embodiments of such information (such as drawings, specification sheets, design notes, source code, object code, load modules, schematics, flow charts, logic diagrams, procedural diagrams, coding sheets, work sheets, documentation, annotations, printouts, studies, manuals, proposals and any other written or machine-readable manuals, proposals and any other written or machine readable expressions of such information as are fixed in any tangible media). 
 
 Other Products and Services : All information relating to consulting, training and other proprietary products or services, whether existing or in various stages of research and development, which are not generally known to the public or within the computer industry or trade in which the Company competes (such as know-how, specifications, technical data, engineering data, processes, techniques, methodologies, and strategies), including, but not limited to, models, consumer behavior insights, mathematical expressions, algorithms and proprietary marketing concepts, and the physical embodiments of such information (such as drawings, schematics, specification sheets, instructor manuals, course materials, training aids, video cassettes, transparencies, slides, taped recordings of presentations, proposals, printouts, studies, contracts, maintenance manuals, documentation, and any other written or machine-readable expressions of such information as are fixed in any tangible media). 
 
 Business Procedures : All information concerning or relating to the way the Company conducts its business which is not generally known to the public (such as internal business procedures, controls, plans, licensing techniques and practices, supplier, subcontractor and prime contractor names and contracts and other vendor information, computer system passwords and other computer security controls, financial information, distributor information, information supplied by clients and customers of Company and employee data) and the physical embodiments of such information (such as check lists, samples, services and operational manuals, contracts, proposals, print-outs, correspondence, forms, listings, ledgers, financial statements, financial reports, financial and operational analyses, financial and operational studies, management reports of every kind, databases, employment records, and any other written or machine-readable expressions of such information as are fixed in any tangible media). 
 
 Marketing Plans and Customer Lists : All information pertaining to Company’s marketing plans and strategies; forecasts and projections; marketing practices, procedures and policies; financial data; discounts; margins; costs; credit terms; pricing practices, procedures and policies; goals and objectives; quoting practices, procedures and policies; and customer data including customer lists, contracts, representatives, requirements and needs, specifications, data provided by or about prospective existing or past customers and contract terms applicable to such customers, and the physical embodiments of such information (such as license agreements, customer lists, print-outs, databases, marketing plans, marketing reports, strategic business plans, marketing analyses and management reports, seminar and class attendee rosters, trade show or exhibit attendee listings, listings of potential customers and leads, and any other written or machine-readable expressions of such information as are fixed in any tangible media). 
 
 Not Generally Known : Any information in addition to the foregoing which is not generally known to the public or within the industry or trade in which the Company competes which gives the Company any advantage over its competitors, and the physical embodiments of such information in any tangible form, whether written or machine-readable in nature. 
 
 P roprietary information and Inventions : Any information that the Company or any Affiliate develops, possesses, owns or develops or that the Company or Affiliate receives under conditions of confidentiality including 
 
 information and Inventions, in whatever form, tangible or intangible, disclosed by the Company or any Affiliate (including their respective employees, agents and independent contractors) to Employee in the course of his employment hereunder; 
 
 information and Inventions, in whatever form, tangible or intangible, developed, created or learned by Employee during the course of his employment hereunder; 
 
 information, in whatever form, tangible or intangible, that has or could have commercial value in the business in which the Company and any Affiliate or their respective clients are engaged or in which they contemplate engaging; 
 
 information, in whatever form, tangible or intangible, that, if disclosed without authorization, could be detrimental to the interest of the Company or any Affiliate whether or not such information is identified as confidential information by the Company or any Affiliate; 
 
 all information, in whatever form, tangible or intangible, on Inventions, hardware configuration information, technology, drawings, engineering, know-how, product information and plans, products, services, research, formats, practices and techniques, marketing plans, business and financial information and plans, strategies, forecasts, unpublished financial statements, budgets, projections, employee lists and information, customer and supplier identities (including, but not limited to, customers and suppliers of the Company or Affiliate with whom Employee becomes acquainted in the course of his employment hereunder) and other business information and agreements disclosed to Employee by the Company or any Affiliate. 
 
 Confidential Information does not include any portions of such information which are now, or which have become publicly known and made generally available through no wrongful act of Employee or others who are under confidentiality obligations as to the item or items involved. 
 
 “ Employment Manual ” means such rules and policies of employment , available at all times on the Company’s HR portal accessible to all employees, as are notified by the Company from time to time. 
 
 “Inventions” means, without limitation, any and all original works of authorship, ideas, concepts, designs, discoveries, inventions, intellectual property rights, databases, mask works, trade secrets, computer software programs and applications, developments, improvements, processes, systems, source codes, formulas, specifications, compositions of matter, experimental and developmental techniques, data, know-how and/or technical information made, learned, conceived, devised, invented, created, or developed by Employee (either solely or under Employee’s direction or jointly with others) during the term of Employee’s employment hereunder, whether or not during the normal working hours or on the premises of the Company and whether or not patentable, copyrightable or protectable as trade secrets . 
 
 “Person” means, without limitation, any individual, firm, corporation, partnership, joint venture, trust, association, joint-stock company, limited liability company, committee, institution, business, organization, authority, government entity or any other entity or body, corporate or incorporate, whether or not having distinct legal personality. 
 
 “ Effective Date” means [● ] . 
 
 1.2 Interpretation: In this Agreement, unless the context otherwise requires: 
 
 (a) all of the provisions of this Agreement (other than where expressly stated to be representations or warranties), where the context requires, are to be construed as covenants as though the words importing such covenants were used in each separate Article hereof : 
 (b) references to Recitals, Articles, Sub-articles, Schedules, and Appendices are to recitals, clauses, sub-clauses and schedules of, and appendices to, this Agreement. Any reference to a paragraph is to a paragraph of the Article or Sub-article in which such reference appears : 
 
 (c) headings are inserted for ease of reference only and are not to be used to define, interpret or limit any of the provisions of this Agreement : 
 
 (d) references to the singular number shall include references to the plural number and vice versa : 
 
 (e) words denoting one gender include both genders : 
 
 (f) any reference in this Agreement to a statutory provision includes that provision and any regulations made in pursuance thereof, as from time to time modified or re-enacted, whether before or after the date of this Agreement, and (so far as liability thereunder may exist or can arise) shall also include any past statutory provisions or regulations (as from time to time modified or re-enacted) which such provisions or regulations have directly or indirectly replaced : 
 
 (g) any reference to a time limit in this Agreement means the time limit set out in the relevant Article or Sub-article or such other time limit which may be mutually agreed by the Parties in writing; 
 
 (h) the English language shall be deemed the language chosen by the P arties hereto to express their mutual intent : and 
 (i) The Employment Manual shall form an integral part of this Agreement. Provided that if there is any conflict between the Agreement and the Employment Manual, the terms of the Employment Manual shall prevail if expressly stated therein . 
 ARTICLE 2 – EMPLOYMENT 
 
 2.1 Commencement of Employment and Term : Effective from and after the Effective Date, the Company hereby employs the Employee to serve in the capacity set forth in Article 3.1, and Employee hereby accepts such employment by Company, upon the terms and subject to the conditions of this Agreement until such time as Employee or the Company may terminate the Agreement in accordance with the terms and conditions hereof. 
 
 2. 3 Representation and Warranty: Employee represents and warrants to the Company that : 
 
 The Employee has the relevant skill sets, qualification and experience required for the purposes of discharging the duties to be assigned by the Company. 
 
 The Employee is not subject to any restraint, limitation or restrictions by virtue of any law, contract or otherwise which would impair his right or ability to enter into employment with the Company or to perform fully his duties and responsibilities hereunder. 
 
 N o conflicti ng obligations exist between the Employee ’ s obligat ion under this Agreement and any other Person . The Employee undertakes to inform the Company of any apparent conflicts between employment for the Company and (a) any obligations he may have to preserve t he confidentiality of any Person’s proprietary information or materials or (b) any rights he claims to any inventions or ideas before using the sam e on Company’s behalf. In the event that the Employee delays or fails in informing the Company of existence of such conflict , the Company may conclude that no such conflict exists, and the Employee agrees thereafter to make no such claim against the Company. The Company shall receive such disclosures in confidence and consistent with the objectives of avoiding any conflict of obligations and rights or the appearance of any conflict of interest . 
 
 ARTICLE 3 – DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITES 
 
 3.1 Designation: During the term of this Agreement , the Employee shall serve on a f ull-time and exclusive basis for the Company as [● Designation ] and shall report to the [● Designati on] . 
 
 3.2 Duties and Responsibilities: T he Employee shall perform all duties and responsibilities provided in Annexure [●] of this Agreement. The Employee acknowledges that the duties and responsibilities provided in this Agre ement are not exhaustive and the Employee shall be required to undertake all tasks that are associated wit h the position of [● Designation ] . The Employee sha ll perform all other duties and responsibilities that are assigned to Employee by the Company from time to time. T he tasks or assignments may be subject to changes pending on marketing activities or project plans. The role may vary, and the Employee shall be called upon to support and collaborate with other department members. In such case, the Employee undertakes to extend the required support and collaborate with relevant department members without any objection or delay. 
 
 3.3 Standard of Performance: In the performance of all of his duties and responsibilities hereunder, the Employee shall be subject to, and shall fully comply with, all of the Company’s policies, rules and regulations as are from time to time in effect and applicable to its employees. So long as Employee is employed under this Agreement, except for statutory holidays, vacations and absences due to temporary illness, Employee shall serve the Company faithfully and to the best of his ability, devoting his full business time, attention, knowledge, energy, skill and effort exclusively on behalf of the Company and for the benefit of the Company and any Affiliates and shall competently and diligently discharge his duties and responsibilities hereunder to the complete satisfaction of the Company. 
 
 3.4 Reservation of Right: The Company reserves the right, in its sole discretion, to change the designation of the Employee at any time and to modify, delete, add or otherwise change Employee’s duties and responsibilities hereunder. 
 
 ARTICLE 4 – PLACE OF EMPLOYMENT AND OFFICE WORKING HOURS 
 
 4.1 Place of Employment: The Employee’s duties and responsibilities shall require Employee’s regular presence at the Company’s principal office at [●] or such other place or places as the Company shall designate . The Employee, in course of his employment, may be required to travel for the business of the Company or any Affiliate, within or outside Pakistan. 
 
 4.2 Regular Working Hours: T he Company’s working hours shall be from [● ] AM to [● ] PM , [● start day ] to [● end day ] , both inclusive. Employee shall be entitled to one (1) hour lunch break . 
 
 4.2 Additional Working Hours: Whe n work requirements dictate, the Em ployee ma y be requested by the Company to , and Employee shall , perform reasonable hours in excess of the normal working hours specified in Article 4.1. Such excess hours worked shall not entitle Employee to any extra remuneration. 
 
 ARTICLE 5– COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS 
 
 5.1 (a ) Salary: The Employee’s salary shall be PKR [● ] per month (the “Salary”). The S alary , subject to such deductions, if any, as specified under the terms of this Agreement including withholding and/or any other applicable tax es , shall be payable on monthly basis in accordance with the Company’s normal payroll schedule. Unless the P arties hereto otherwise agree in writing, the Company shall pay the S alary by a direct deposit to Employee’s bank account, details of which are to be provided by Employee. 
 
 (b) Allowances : In addition to the Salary, the Employee shall be entitl ed to only such allowances, as permissible under the Employment Manual. The Company shall, by way of reimbursement and/or direct payment, pay or procure to be paid to the Employee all reasonable and pre-approved allowances wholly, exclusively and necessarily incurred by him in the performance of hi s duties under the Agreement. 
 
 (c) Confidentiality of Compensation : The Employee acknowledges that compensation provided under this Agreement is confidential and must be maintained in strict secrecy and must not be disclosed to any third party. If improperly used or disclosed such action shall be subject to disciplinary action, including termination of employment and legal action. 
 
 5. 2 Annual Bonus : The Employee shall be entitled to annual bonus as per the policies of Company/ Employment Manual. 
 
 5.3 Health Insurance: The Employee shall be entitled to health insurance as per the policies of the Company/Employment Manual. 
 
 5. 4 Total Remuneration: Subject to Applicable Law, th e S alary and allowances specified in Articles 5.1 represent the Employee’s full entitlement
